note: Unlock steps come from the Star Stable Wiki and Star Stable help pages. Quests change over time, so treat them as a guide.

regions.name: Marchenghast
regions.blurb: A foggy, blighted forest and castle trapped in time, home to the Saltus Witches.
unlock: Access to Goldenhills Valley first (level 12 and the South Iron Gate key)
quests: The Blight (teaches you the lantern and leads you to the Veiled Hamlet)
Meet Martha, Meet Betty and Meet Mercy
The petrified prison (free the trapped Mahrs)
Ilwedrisch, a special Mahr
A friend in need (needs Liked with the Castle and the Saltus witches)
Dailies: Guiding the Waldfenggen, Blighted Nicchus

regions.name: Goldenhills Valley
regions.blurb: Golden fields between Silverglade and Marchenghast, with Goldenleaf Stable and a fishing village.
unlock: Mysteries of the Circus and The Meeting in Sacred Grove
The Key is Ready: forge the key and open the South Iron Gate
quests: The Key is Ready (opens the gate)
The red little mystery fox, a hidden 7-day questline (starts with a mushroom in Aideen's Whisper)
Halloween events around Goldenleaf Forest and Scarecrow Hill
places: Goldenleaf Stable (horse shop, hotel, two racetracks)

pois.note: Home stable, horse shop and hostel

regions.name: Medieval Camp
regions.blurb: Knights, jousting and dragon horses in the Forgotten Fields.
unlock: Finish repairing the bridge to the Harvest Counties in Nilmer's Highland
quests: Reconcile the feuding Medieval Houses (Blue Oaks, Yellow Wolves, Knights Errant, Cerise Unicorns)
Face the Black Knight
Jousting for your House's lance and shield
Target Practice with Robyn the Good of Aim
places: Magical horse market (Aldrach, Faramawr, Ryume, Keima)
Races: The Gauntlet and The Gauntlet Reversed

regions.name: Silverglade
regions.blurb: The heart of Jorvik: Silverglade Village, the Equestrian Center, the Manor and Steve's Farm.
unlock: Help Thomas Moorland get back Moorland Stables' stolen ownership papers
quests: The main story continues here
Mysteries of the Circus and The Meeting in Sacred Grove (both needed for Goldenhills Valley)
places: Silverglade Equestrian Center (Black Tie and Tails pet shop)

pois.note: Home stable. Horse trailer behind the barn

regions.name: Moorland
regions.blurb: Where everyone starts. Moorland Stables, the lighthouse and the Bazaar live here.
unlock: Open from the start, even for free players
quests: The first story quests at Moorland Stables
Gary Goldtooth's magical horses and pets show up by the lighthouse
The Traveling Bazaar and festivals set up here
regions.buyNote: Gary Goldtooth's magical horses and pets only visit for a few weeks at a time.

regions.name: Fort Pinta
regions.blurb: The harbor town with the beach, ferries and the bus to Jorvik City.
unlock: Open from the start, even for free players
quests: James gives you the quest that opens South Hoof Peninsula (level 7)
Fort Pinta Championship on the beach
places: Pet Shop Girls (pets and your first saddlebag)
Disco (Fri and Sat from 8 PM server time)
Ferries to Cape West, Jarlaheim and South Hoof
Races: Mayor Peanut's Fitness Circuit, Fort Pinta Scenic Circuit

regions.name: Hollow Woods
regions.blurb: A huge magical forest in Valedale, home of the druids and the unicorns.
quests: Meet Wynna Sunbeam at the magic runestone to start druidism
Path of Whimsy (collect Light from fireflies and wisps)
Path of Runeology (rune puzzles)
Path of Terra
places: Races: Hollow Woods Race, Firefly's Folly

regions.name: Valedale
regions.blurb: A druid village by the Silversong River and Valedale Lake.
quests: Lots of main story quests
Soul Riding with Rhiannon at the Druid Paddock (leads to a free Rune Runner horse)
Elizabeth Sunbeam, who later opens the road to the Valley of the Hidden Dinosaur

regions.name: Valley of the Hidden Dinosaur
regions.blurb: A frozen valley with Nic Stoneground's fossil camp and no stable or village.
unlock: Meet Nic Stoneground in the Everwind Fields and finish his quests
quests: Check whether the valley entrance has thawed for Elizabeth Sunbeam
The Frozen Road
Help set up Nic's camp and hunt for fossils
Fix Nic's hot air balloon

regions.name: Firgrove
regions.blurb: A mountain village on the way to Mistfall.
quests: The tourists Helga, Gretchen and Gunther
Mrs. Packard's rental invoice (opens Mistfall)
A hidden quest in the mountains

regions.name: Starshine Ranch
regions.blurb: The only western-riding place in Jorvik, and home of Camp Western.
unlock: Help Thomas Moorland get back Moorland Stables' stolen ownership papers
quests: Mary's Lost Animals
The Tumbleweed Rodeo
Dances with Chickens
Scouting with Josh
places: Western Games: pole bending, barrel racing, Josh's Western Race

regions.name: Mistfall
regions.blurb: Misty forests around the Viking-style town of Dundull.
unlock: Mrs. Packard in Firgrove gives you her rental invoice
quests: Help Kit deliver Mistfoxes so you can buy one
Jorvik Ranger training
Search and Rescue orienteering
places: Races: South Mistfall Forest, Bramble Gorge

regions.name: Wildwoods
regions.blurb: Untouched forest where the three Jorvik Wild Horse herds live.
unlock: Then speak to Rania: Open Wildwoods - An Impossible Expedition
quests: Open Wildwoods - An Impossible Expedition
The first ranger expedition (opens the north)
The Lignos lead you over the Sentinel Tree bridge
places: Foresters' woods, Mystics' swamp, Warriors' highland

regions.name: The Harvest Counties
regions.blurb: Farmland with Jarlaheim, Jorvik Stables and Greendale.
unlock: Opens through the main story (the bridge from Nilmer's Highland)
quests: Jack Goldspur's search for a new mayor
Herman on Vacation and the GED quests
Reputation with the Jarlasson and Goldspur families (all needed for Epona)

regions.name: Epona
regions.blurb: The southern island with New Hillcrest, Crescent Moon Village and Fort Maria.
unlock: Friendly with Jorvik Stables, the GED Jarlaheim Office, the Jarlasson family and the Goldspur family
Ends with the GED quest A step up in your career?
quests: The unlock questline starts with a text from Herman
Professor Hayden and Alberta's spiderlings (gives a spider pet)
Fort Maria story quests

regions.name: Jorvik Riding Camp
regions.blurb: A small island made to welcome new players.

regions.name: South Hoof Peninsula
regions.blurb: A rescue ranch, a hermit and wild horses down south.
unlock: Get the quest from James in Fort Pinta
Take the ferry (or the bridge from New Hillcrest once it's built)
quests: Quests to set up the three shops
Rescue Ranch tasks
Befriend the Hermit to buy the Welsh Pony

regions.name: Jorvik City
regions.blurb: The capital, east of Silverglade. You get there by bus.
unlock: Take the bus from Fort Pinta (no longer needs Star Rider)
quests: Go with Rania Varanger to Jorvik City Mall
